spans.says: At Google, 75% of all new code is generated by AI. Engineers approve it.
You just cannot keep your head down to write code anymore.

So picture how much demand is left for an engineer who only wants to sit there and code. Code got cheap, but outcomes didn't. A company doesn't pay you for the code. It pays you for what the code does to the business.
Don't be the engineer who only codes. Be the engineer who owns a number.
